channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont nonprofits have ended racial equity lending programs amid federal pressure. Champlain Housing Trust and others stopped offering loans exclusively for people of color to protect federal funding. Advocates say this is a setback for addressing housing disparities.

A Brattleboro man faces stalking and threatening charges after targeting a Walgreens employee. Michael Bennett allegedly followed and threatened the worker after rejected advances. He was arraigned this week and has a history of violent offenses.

A tragic crash in Warren Vermont has claimed the life of a fourteen-year-old passenger. The sixteen-year-old driver suffered minor injuries and is recovering. The community and Harwood School District are mourning this loss and offering support.

Lead contamination is found in drinking water at forty-two percent of New York schools. Adirondack counties like St. Lawrence and Lewis have some of the highest rates. Advocates urge stricter limits and filters to protect children’s health.
